Heard Mr. P. Sarma, learned counsel appearing on behalf of Mr. B. Nath, learned counsel for the appellant who submits that the engaged counsel Mr. B. Nath, is intending to withdraw the vakalatnama.

The counsel for the appellant after informing the appellant by sending him a notice in that regard by way of speed post and give proof of sending such notice, may be produced before this Court on the Page No.# 4/4 next date fixed.

2. On the other hand, Mr. B. Dutta, learned Senior counsel, assisted by Mr. S. Deka, learned counsel has submitted that this matter has become infructuous, inasmuch as, this appeal has been filed by the appellant, impugning an order of interim injunction dated 04.11.2023.

sentences.text: The learned senior counsel submits that though no stay has been granted in this appeal, however, due to pendency, this appeal, may impact the disposal of the Misc(J) Case No. 283/2023, by the trial Court.
He also submits that next date of the said Misc Case is fixed on 18.03.2026.

3. Mr. M. Dutta, learned counsel appears for the respondent No.4 adopts the submission of the learned senior counsel for the respondent No.1, 2 and 3.
4.
Considering the facts and circumstance of the present case, where the engaged counsel of the appellant is intending to withdraw his vakalatnama, this appeal cannot be disposed of at this stage.
However, it is hereby made clear that pendency of this appeal shall not be a bar for the trial Court to proceed with the Misc(J) Case No. 283/2023.
The trial Court shall make an endeavour to dispose of the said Misc Case as expeditiously as possible.
5. List the matter on 23.03.2026.
